cycles.label: FY 2027 and earlier
cycles.note: Pay valid prior-year obligations, reconcile records, and support closeout and audit. Some prior-year authority may still be available.

cycles.label: FY 2028
cycles.note: Apportion, allot, incur obligations, and make payments. The $10 worked example belongs to this cycle.

cycles.label: FY 2029
cycles.note: In this illustrative spring snapshot, the next-year proposal is under congressional consideration while agencies continue their budget work.

cycles.label: FY 2030
cycles.note: Spring planning for a later budget can begin while next-year legislation and current-year execution are still underway.
